title: Teaching himself drums
summary: Without lessons he learned from watching drummers, practised on a wash tub, and bought a first set of drums while playing house parties with Baby Brewster.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: And I used to watch Baby Dots anytime when I got a chance to go hear them, and I used to watch Henry Martin, I watched Black Benny, and Red Happy, and all those fellas that was making a name for themselves. And, well I never did learn music, I just taken interest, so much interest in it that I fell in love with the drums and I'd taken them up.
When you were a kid, did you play on any toy drums or beat on anything?

No, no, no. I didn't beat on it. All I beat it on was the bottom of my mother's old wash tub or upside the fence, yeah. Yeah. So around 1918 I went to work at the Whitney National Bank as a night port. At that time they had Bud Russel, I know you know him. I've heard him. Ed Darcy was working there. Well Ed Darcy's still with him, yeah, but Bud Russel died. Well I was playing piano with a boyfriend of mine named Shedrick Brewster, but we called him nicknamed Baby Brewster, and we used to play house parties on Sundays. In fact we played practically all over town. Well I had bought me a brand new set of drums from Wordless I sent out to Chicago for him. And that's how I started getting the fundamentals of drums. I didn't have nobody to teach me. I wasn't able to pay nobody for a music lesson. Well Henry Martin he'd done the best he could for me when I was trying to learn, but he wasn't learning how to read. How did Henry Martin play?
